description: Deterministic eligibility criteria for technical university faculty hiring. The Evaluator node loads this file and applies pure-Python logic against extracted candidate data. The LLM is NEVER used for math or pass/fail logic.

eligibility_decisions.Retain: Candidate meets all mandatory criteria for the applied role.
eligibility_decisions.Downgrade: Candidate fails criteria for the applied role but qualifies for a lower role.
eligibility_decisions.Reject: Candidate fails all applicable role thresholds.

Assistant Professor.label: Entry-level faculty
Assistant Professor.first_class_rule: First Class required in EITHER B.Tech OR M.Tech (at least one).

Associate Professor.label: Mid-career faculty
Associate Professor.first_class_rule: First Class required in ANY ONE degree (B.Tech, M.Tech, or Ph.D. qualifying).

Professor.label: Senior faculty - two qualification paths (A or B)

Path A.first_class_rule: First Class required in ANY ONE degree.
Path A.publications_context: Must have been achieved at the Associate Professor level (i.e., publications after/promoted-to Associate).

Path B.first_class_rule: First Class required in ANY ONE degree.
Path B.publications_context: Total cumulative publications across the candidate's career.

tier2_comparative_scoring.description: Deterministic weighted score (0-100) used to rank retained candidates once Tier 1 eligibility is satisfied. Code computes this directly; the LLM does not.
notes: Each metric is normalized to its benchmark maximum (clamped to 1.0) before weighting.
score_breakdown in EvaluationResult reports each metric's weighted contribution out of 100.
Only candidates with Tier 1 decision == 'Retain' are meaningfully ranked by this score.
